about: Western Express Freight LLC is a leading freight forwarding company based in Dubai. Formed by experienced and managed by well-trained professionals, we operate in and across the Middle East offering top-class services in freight forwarding. With the sole aim of becoming a client-oriented freight forwarder, we ensure hassle-free shipments while offering worldwide logistics.
